incidents.name: HEALTH transfer logic flaw
incidents.notes: HEALTH's _transfer() lets a transfer to the liquidity pair reduce the pair's own token balance without a sync(), so the attacker repeatedly shrank the reserve and swapped a small holding out for the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: HEALTH 0x32B166e082993Af6598a89397E82e123ca44e74E created 2022-09-03T14:53:04Z by 0xd8d2879af8b0c2851972a5bf0b1fc13d1ef28509, unrelated to attack sender 0xde78112ff006f166e4ccfe1dfe4181c9619d3b5d; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 16.6752 WBNB left the pair and 16.6419 WBNB reached the attacker; 16.6419 WBNB x $272.65 at incidentTimestamp 1666264107 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $4,537.
